one_line: New models launch, AI reaches consumer products, safety tools advance, and infrastructure expands.

themes.title: New AI models and SDKs released
themes.text: NVIDIA announced a suite of open‑weight models for European developers, Mistral AI previewed its 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4, released the Voxtral 3 voice‑agent SDK, and Anthropic opened Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent, for research preview.

stories.headline: NVIDIA launches open Nemotron 3.5 and Kumo models for European industries
Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview

themes.title: AI features added to consumer services
themes.text: Google enabled Gemini conversational navigation on Apple CarPlay, Walmart introduced an Agent Gateway for shoppers to link personal AI agents, and Mistral partnered with Mozilla to power the Firefox Smart Window browsing assistant.

stories.headline: Google adds conversational Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay in US
Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
Mistral and Mozilla launch AI‑powered Firefox Smart Window beta

themes.title: AI tools strengthen software security
themes.text: AI systems from OpenAI and Google identified critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting many websites, OpenAI launched Patch the Planet to coordinate open‑source bug response, and outlined a partnership approach for consistent safeguards.

stories.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites
OpenAI launches Patch the Planet to coordinate response to critical open‑source bugs
OpenAI outlines partnership approach for consistent safeguards and responsible access

themes.title: Infrastructure growth for AI workloads
themes.text: Google Cloud and NVIDIA made Vera Rubin A5X instances generally available, NVIDIA added Confidential Bare Metal for secure model deployment, OpenAI placed its models and Codex workflows on Google Cloud Marketplace, and announced GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models for private preview on Google Cloud.

stories.headline: Google Cloud and NVIDIA launch general availability of Vera Rubin A5X instances
NVIDIA expands Confidential Computing with Confidential Bare Metal for model builders
OpenAI models and Codex workflows added to Google Cloud Marketplace
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud
